s: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 made which city the sole, permanent capital of Andhra Pradesh?
x: The AP Reorganisation (Amendment) Act, 2026 amended Section 5 to make Amaravati the sole, permanent capital of AP with effect from 2 June 2024.

new.s: Which railway zone, India's 18th, became operational on 1 June 2026 with headquarters at Visakhapatnam?
new.x: South Coast Railway, the 18th railway zone with HQ at Visakhapatnam, became operational on 1 June 2026.

new.s: Where is the headquarters of the South Coast Railway zone that became operational in June 2026?
new.x: The South Coast Railway (18th zone) has its headquarters at Visakhapatnam.

new.s: Andhra Pradesh's number of districts rose to how many on 31 December 2025?
new.x: AP's districts went from 26 to 28 on 31 Dec 2025 with the new Polavaram and Markapuram districts.

new.s: Which two new districts were formed in Andhra Pradesh on 31 December 2025?
new.x: Polavaram (HQ Rampachodavaram) and Markapuram became AP's 27th and 28th districts on 31 Dec 2025.

new.s: What is the headquarters of the new Polavaram district formed in Andhra Pradesh in December 2025?
new.x: The new Polavaram district has its headquarters at Rampachodavaram.

s: On which date was AP's Stree Shakti free bus travel scheme for women launched?
x: Stree Shakti, free APSRTC bus travel for women under Super Six, was launched on 15 August 2025.

new.s: AP's Zero Poverty – P4 initiative was launched on which occasion in 2025?
new.x: Zero Poverty – P4 was launched on 30 March 2025 (Ugadi).

new.s: Under AP's P4 (Zero Poverty) model, the top 10% of families support which group?
new.x: Under P4, the top 10% support the bottom 20% of families.

new.s: By which year does AP's Zero Poverty – P4 aim to end extreme poverty?
new.x: P4, the base of Swarna Andhra @2047, aims to end extreme poverty by 2030.

new.s: How much does a farmer get a year under AP's Annadata Sukhibhava scheme (including PM-KISAN)?
new.x: Annadata Sukhibhava gives Rs 20,000 a year (Rs 14,000 State + Rs 6,000 PM-KISAN), tenants included.

new.s: Which AP scheme of 2025 gives self-owned auto owners Rs 15,000 a year?
new.x: Auto Driver Sevalo (2025), successor of Vahana Mitra, gives auto owners Rs 15,000 a year.

new.s: Under the AP health insurance model announced in May 2025, what is the cover per family a year?
new.x: The May 2025 insurance model gives cover up to Rs 25 lakh per family a year for 1.65 crore families.

new.s: How many free LPG cylinders a year does AP's Deepam-2 scheme give?
new.x: Deepam-2 (Super Six) gives 3 free LPG cylinders a year to 83 lakh families.

new.s: What is the monthly old-age pension under AP's NTR Bharosa from June 2024?
new.x: NTR Bharosa pays Rs 4,000 a month to the old aged and widows.

new.s: Which app replaced AP's Disha women's safety SOS app in 2025?
new.x: The Disha app (2020) was replaced by Suraksha in 2025.

new.s: Which scheme replaced Jagananna Amma Vodi in Andhra Pradesh?
new.x: Talliki Vandanam (Super Six) replaced Amma Vodi, giving Rs 15,000 per school-going child a year.

new.s: At which place in Palnadu were 62 rural Anna Canteens opened on 15 April 2026?
new.x: 62 rural Anna Canteens were opened at Dharanikota (Palnadu) on 15 April 2026.

new.s: What is the name of AP's State-level deceased organ donation and transplantation programme?
new.x: Jeevandan is AP's deceased organ donation and transplantation programme.

new.s: Which body put the Indus Waters Treaty "in abeyance" from 23 April 2025?
new.x: After the Pahalgam attack the Cabinet Committee on Security put the IWT in abeyance from 23 April 2025.

new.s: How many terror sites in PoJK and Pakistan were struck under Operation Sindoor?
new.x: Operation Sindoor struck 9 terror sites in PoJK and Pakistan after the Pahalgam attack.

new.s: In October 2024 the India-Pakistan Kartarpur Corridor agreement was renewed for how long?
new.x: The Kartarpur Corridor agreement was renewed for 5 years in October 2024.

new.s: In which month did India close the Kartarpur Corridor after Operation Sindoor?
new.x: India closed the Kartarpur Corridor in May 2025 after Operation Sindoor.

new.s: Sawalkote (1,856 MW) and Kirthai-II (930 MW), pushed after the IWT abeyance, are on which river?
new.x: After the IWT abeyance India pushed the Chenab projects Kirthai-II and Sawalkote (Jun 2026).

new.s: Where did the Court of Arbitration sit that ruled on the Ratle case under the Indus Waters Treaty in 2026?
new.x: The PCA Court of Arbitration at The Hague held in the Ratle case that the Treaty remains in force.

s: Which airbase in eastern Ladakh, built by BRO at about 13,000 ft, became operational in 2025-26?
x: The Mudh-Nyoma airbase (~13,000 ft, BRO) in eastern Ladakh became operational.

new.s: At which meeting was the October 2024 India-China understanding on Depsang and Demchok backed by Modi and Xi?
new.x: The October 2024 disengagement understanding was backed at the Modi–Xi meeting in Kazan.

new.s: Who led India in the 25th round of India-China Special Representatives talks in Beijing in August 2026?
new.x: The 25th SR talks (Beijing, Aug 2026) were between NSA Ajit Doval and Wang Yi.

new.s: How many places in Arunachal Pradesh did China 'rename' in May 2025?
new.x: China 'standardised' names of 27 places in Arunachal Pradesh in May 2025; India rejected it.

new.s: On which river is China building the mega dam over which India raised concern in August 2025?
new.x: China's mega dam is on the Yarlung Tsangpo (Brahmaputra); India raised concern in Aug 2025.

new.s: Which valley, ceded by Pakistan to China in 1963, saw a fresh India-China dispute in January 2026?
new.x: The Shaksgam Valley (Trans-Karakoram Tract) saw a fresh dispute in January 2026.

new.s: Where was the 18th BRICS Summit held in September 2026?
new.x: The 18th BRICS Summit was held in New Delhi in September 2026.

new.s: Which party's government led by Tarique Rahman was sworn in in Bangladesh in February 2026?
new.x: A BNP government under Tarique Rahman was sworn in in February 2026.

new.s: Who represented India at the swearing-in of Bangladesh's Tarique Rahman government in February 2026?
new.x: Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla represented India at the February 2026 swearing-in.

new.s: Who became Nepal's youngest Prime Minister (35) in March 2026?
new.x: Balen Shah (Rastriya Swatantra Party) became Nepal's youngest PM in March 2026.

new.s: Who became Nepal's interim Prime Minister after K.P. Sharma Oli fell in the Gen-Z protests of September 2025?
new.x: After Oli fell in the Sep 2025 Gen-Z protests, Sushila Karki became interim PM.

new.s: Which country's payment system Favara was linked with India's UPI in August 2026?
new.x: The Maldives' Favara was linked with UPI in August 2026.

new.s: Balen Shah, Nepal's PM from March 2026, belongs to which party?
new.x: Balen Shah belongs to the Rastriya Swatantra Party.
